design.logo_discipline: ONE LOGO PER SLIDE. Only slides 1 (cover) and 12 (closing) get the actual Kefi Tech logo image. All other 10 slides use `KEFI TECH`. Foot-rail on EVERY slide uses the text wordmark.

design.v6_fixes_applied: Fix 1 (logo padding-left), Fix 2 (taller COMPONENTS panel 400px), Fix 3 (architecture justify-content space-between), Fix 4 (full capability names on cover), Fix 5 (industry-specific architecture content — 320 real entries).

slides.title: Cover — Quality & Security Engineering for BFSI & Insurance
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Apply .brand-stripe (6px left edge, top 60% #004c97, bottom 40% #ff6c0e). Top-left: `` (260px wide, with 10px left padding to clear brand stripe) at top:64px / left:104px. Top-right: small JetBrains Mono 'QUALITY & SECURITY ENGINEERING SERVICES · 2026' in --text-muted. Center-left (~y=240): eyebrow 'KEFI TECH · BFSI & INSURANCE' in --brand; huge display headline at --fs-display (64px) on two stacked lines (Sora 700/800): line 1 'Quality & Security Engineering' in --primary, line 2 'for BFSI & Insurance.' in --accent orange.
